outlook.statement: Targeting a turnover increase of 25% in FY 2026-27. Focus on highest-yielding segments: Digital Wallpaper and Catalogue manufacturing. Aggressively targeting exports. Participation in Frankfurt trade exhibition in January 2026 generated good leads. New machine added in January 2026 (fourth overall) will boost turnover and margins. Company remains near zero debt.

risks: Unpredictable costs for base substrates severely threaten profit margins
Inflow of cheap Chinese imports continues to erode margins and disrupt quality perception
Currency volatility has escalated import costs
Small-cap company in conservative market is a cause of concern for operating profits
99.93% of revenue is from related party transactions
Audit trail feature not enabled for fixed asset records and inventory records maintained on Excel and Anmol software
The company has very high concentration of credit risk to a single customer which is a related party.
Demographic Risk: This is the risk of variability of results due to unsystematic nature of decrements that include mortality, withdrawal, disability and retirement.
Salary Inflation Risk: Higher than expected increases in salary will increase the defined benefit obligation
Interest-Rate Risk: The defined benefit obligation calculated uses a discount rate based on government bonds. If bond yields fall, the defined benefit obligation will tend to increase.
